scripts.migrations:add: dotnet ef migrations add --project CmsApi.Data --startup-project CmsApi --context WriteDbContext --output-dir Migrations
scripts.migrations:up: dotnet ef database update --project CmsApi.Data --startup-project CmsApi --context WriteDbContext -- --environment Development
scripts.dev: dotnet r services:up migrations:up && dotnet build && (trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; dotnet run --no-build --project CmsApi.Worker & dotnet run --no-build --project CmsApi; wait)
